captures.q: Enoch AI dating Dead Sea Scrolls
captures.description: ENOCH, BY THE OPERATOR'S ADDRESS 'ENOCH AI DATING DEAD SEA SCROLLS', ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'Researchers at the University of Groningen developed an artificial intelligence model named Enoch to re-date the Dead Sea Scrolls.' Training data, method, accuracy, findings (older timelines, 4Q114 Daniel and 4Q109 Ecclesiastes), the reaction (supporters, Reddit sceptics), a closing quotation of Popović from Haaretz. Nine cards: the PLOS article, the BAS, Reddit, the Jerusalem Post, Haaretz, the NIH copy of the article, a National Geographic post, two videos.

atoms.evidence: Researchers at the University of Groningen developed an artificial intelligence model named
Accuracy: Enoch predicts dates with a mean absolute error of roughly 28 to 31 years, and 79% of its estimates for 135 undated scrolls aligned realistically with human paleographic evaluations.
It combines Bayesian ridge regression, radiocarbon dating, and machine-learning handwriting analysis
